{{Quote|The symbol you see signifies a permanent unity between our world and yours. It ''binds us all'' to a shared cause.|Troov|<ref name="The Runaway Ride" />}}
'''Troov''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiin]] [[General/Legends|general]] who aided, allied, and supported the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Liberation of Nothoiin|liberation]] of [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[Goldskin Parade|celebration]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] freedom, General Troov aided in the [[Ambush of the Goldskin Parade|capture]] of the notorious [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]].<ref name="The Runaway Ride" />
